findings:
🔵 [engine-c-status-unasserted] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The engine block prints `c_status`/`reason` but asserts only impl_calls/review_calls/journal flags; adding an assertion that the resumed status is not `blocked` would make the end-to-end claim regression-proof. Excluded because admission through the engine is already proven by `c_review_calls=true` and `c_impl_calls=0`, and the mocked event appender cannot faithfully drive post-review phases, so the stricter assertion belongs with the follow-up per-seat final-panel reuse unit.
🔵 [intake-cap-keyed-on-phase] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Intake skips the changed-file cap on `phase === REVIEWING` while cli keys it on `reviewingResumable` (REVIEWING && bound candidate); equivalent in practice because REVIEWING is in `resumableCandidatePhase` and candidate resolution precedes the cap check, but aligning the two predicates would remove the asymmetry. Not blocking: no admission path reaches the cap bypass without a resolved candidate.
